name: bizplug-tutoring
description: The tutoring & test prep plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book tutoring sessions and prep trials. It works from the business's own published profile, covering subjects, rates, availability and booking, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Book tutoring sessions and prep trials for tutoring & test prep businesses.
